rationale: AMLAS v1.1 Stage 4 (Model Learning, pp. 32–34) explicitly warns that a model can overfit development data (Note 29), provides an example where image artefacts from simulator data can be accommodated as noise leading to overfitting/spurious boundaries (Example 26), identifies data leakage when development has a view of internal test data (Activity 11, footnote 5), and requires a Model Development Log (Artefact [U]) documenting and justifying key learning decisions. The claim accurately reflects these guidance points without overclaiming universal simulator failure or conflating internal test data with independent verification data.
evidence_locators: AMLAS v1.1, PDF pp. 32–34 (Stage 4: Model Learning, Note 29, Example 26, Artefact [U], Activity 11 and footnote 5)
limitations: AMLAS provides process guidance and illustrative examples rather than empirical failure rates for specific simulator artifacts or absolute prevention guarantees against leakage.
